payload.purpose_context: Today only tactics can be read through the charter API and nothing can be written. This mission builds the shared relationship and graph core and takes the regular charter artefacts (directive, styleguide, paradigm, and the new toolguide) through a consistent read and functional-registration surface, so pack authors and tooling can fetch and register artefacts and the relationships between them. Grounded in ADR-0025 and ADR-0026.
payload.purpose_tldr: Let clients read and register the charter's regular artefacts and their relationships through the API.

options: Tactic (extend existing read slice with registration + relationships)
Toolguide (new kind, simplest, full add-a-kind + read + registration)
Directive (dangling existing kind, prove read wiring + registration)
payload.question: Which artefact kind should be the step-2 reference slice taken end-to-end through read + registration first?

payload.final_answer: Directive is the step-2 reference slice. Directives are top-level DRG entry points (referenced by paradigms); tactics seldom are, so Directive better exercises the graph walk and relationship registration end to end.

options: Build the kind registry now (this mission is ADR-0024 trigger)
Copy the Tactic slice per kind, defer the registry to #169
Hybrid: registry for the read/registration dispatch only
payload.question: Build the per-kind registry now (#169) or copy the Tactic slice per kind for this mission?

payload.final_answer: Copy the Tactic slice per kind; defer the registry to #169. Operator's rationale: keep each kind detached and clearly modelled so they evolve independently; a shared abstraction risks over-coupling their behaviour and cascade issues; accept the near-duplication to avoid premature generalization.
